ast_find_references.description: Finds type-resolved references and returns bounded project-relative locations, including declaration impact by default. When @angular/compiler resolves, it also reports Angular template usages, including consumer templates, tagged by origin with a template_coverage verdict; completed covers templates inside the Project only, incomplete coverage does not prove absence, and template errors are not diagnosed.

detail.description: Result detail: locations omits source lines; context adds bounded source-line text.

output_format.description: Result representation. TOON wraps one compact encoded value in structuredContent.

project_root.description: Absolute project directory containing tsconfig.json, or the config path.

symbol_path.description: Exact symbol path returned by an outline or symbol search.

ast_rename_symbol.description: Prepares an exact hash-bound rename plan without writing. Review the preview and apply its operation_id with ast_apply_operation. The plan also rewrites external Angular templates, including consumer templates when coverage is completed, hash-bound to the workspace snapshot; diagnostics stay TypeScript-only.

allow_new_errors.description: Permit a plan with new TypeScript errors after explicit review.

block_on_template_errors.description: Block the plan when a completed template check adds template errors. allow_new_errors still waives it.

dry_run.description: Compatibility field. Direct application is disabled; this tool always prepares.

new_name.description: New identifier only, without a container prefix.
